verdict.rationale: Community posts suggest DeepSeek models are released openly: one notes downloadable native-precision weights (~154 GB) for running locally, another calls it "open-source" progress, and distilled variants are mentioned. No first-party evidence names a license or confirms that source code, rather than just weights, is readable. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of an open license (license name and terms), evidence of readable source code beyond model weights, and an official repository link.
